Hi Emily —

Thanks again for your interest in an on-site demo. We had capacity open the week of Aug 7–11 and wanted to propose a single-day visit on Thursday, Aug 9. High-level plan: 9:30am arrival, 10:00–12:00 technical demo + integration Q&A, 12:00–1:00 lunch (light + vegetarian options), 1:00–3:00 deeper ops/PII-handling discussion and runbook review.

A few asks from our side so we can finalize logistics:
- Can your team confirm attendees (name + role) for the day?
- We’ll need to run a short NDA prior to the visit — I can send a DocuSign link once you confirm attendee emails.
- Preferred room: we initially booked Conf Room 2B but Karthik flagged that Lab Room 3 has dedicated GPU power and a breakout station — would Aventra be OK if we use Lab Room 3 instead?
- If you have any internal requirements (badging, escort, laptop whitelist), please share.

I’ve looped in Karthik (solutions) and Monica (ops) to coordinate AV and site access. We can push a calendar hold once you confirm the date.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Engagement Lead

Thanks — lab room 3 is definitely the right call for an interactive session. Quick tech checklist for ops and Aventra so we don’t hit delays on the day:

- Physical: Lab Room 3 reserved and will need 2 guest chairs at the main bench + breakout table (I’ll bring one spare laptop).
- AV: HDMI + DisplayPort adapters on hand, dedicated power strip with 20A circuit (lab 3 has it).
- Networking: Please whitelist the following outbound nodes for the demo laptop: 13.59.24.90, api-redwood-inference.prod (we’ll provide final FQDNs). If Aventra uses an internal firewall we’ll provide a short list to add to their allowlist.
- Images & data: Bring a sanitized sample dataset (PII redacted) — if you want we can provide a stripped-down synthetic CSV for preloading.
- Timeline buffer: plan a 15–20 minute setup window before 10:00 to verify GPU availability and model artifacts.

Monica — can you confirm lab room 3 availability for Aug 9 and add the GPU power check to the room reservation? Also, I’ll need a short test account provisioned on the guest VLAN.

-Karthik
